title: Agent rules split into folder-scoped AGENTS.md and shared skills
summary: This change reorganises how coding agents are told the rules of this repository. The root AGENTS.md shrinks to cross-cutting rules and gains a routing table; the code-layout, workflow and skill rules move into folder-scoped AGENTS.md files under crates/ and .github/workflows/, and into seven new skills under .agents/skills/. Claude Code, which only reads .claude/skills, is served by a git symlink to .agents/skills, and CI gains two steps that lint every skill and fail if that symlink is not a real symlink. Alongside the docs, osf scan now skips symlinks instead of reading through them, so the symlinked skills folder is never scanned as a duplicate of its target.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.subtitle: Root rules, read by every agent
nodes.summary: Rewritten: cross-cutting rules stay, each now carrying a Checked by / Not checked note. Working posture, code layout, branches and bootstrap choices move out to folder-scoped files, and a routing table maps a folder or skill to the rules it loads.

nodes.label: .agents/README.md
nodes.subtitle: Why .claude/skills is a symlink
nodes.summary: New. Explains that .agents/ is the one home for shared agent configuration, that Claude Code reads only .claude/skills, and why this repository keeps no CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: crates/AGENTS.md
nodes.subtitle: Code layout, language, tests
nodes.summary: New. Holds the crate layout rules lifted out of the root file, the Rust decision, and the four commands a change under crates/ must pass before it is pushed.

nodes.label: .github/workflows/AGENTS.md
nodes.subtitle: Secrets, permissions, pinning
nodes.summary: New. Rules for workflow files: judge jobs defined on the base branch, no pull request code in a job holding a secret, actions pinned to a commit SHA, least privilege, harden-runner in block mode, review aids that never block a merge.

nodes.label: skills/README.md
nodes.subtitle: Shipped skills and how to install
nodes.summary: New. Says skills/ holds what this repository ships to adopters, how to install one with npx skills add, and that repository-internal skills live in .agents/skills/ instead.

nodes.label: skills/show-me, skills/pr-outline
nodes.subtitle: Shipped to adopters
nodes.summary: The two skills this repository ships. Unchanged here, but now named by the root routing table and by the new CI skill lint.

nodes.label: .agents/skills/
nodes.subtitle: Seven repository-internal skills
nodes.summary: New home for the skills an agent uses while working on this repository: adding-an-osf-command, filing-an-issue, opening-a-pull-request, reviewing-a-pull-request, running-sub-agents, writing-a-workflow. Each rule carries a Checked by or Not checked note.

nodes.label: .claude/skills
nodes.subtitle: Symlink to ../.agents/skills
nodes.summary: New git symlink, mode 120000. Claude Code reads only .claude/skills, so this link is what makes the shared .agents/skills tree visible to it without a second copy.

nodes.label: osf
nodes.subtitle: Thin command-line shell
nodes.summary: The binary CI builds and then runs for the skill lint. Unchanged by this diff.

nodes.label: scan_paths
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/scan/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Now checks symlink_metadata before reading each tracked path and skips anything that is a symlink, so a link is never read as the file or directory it points at.

nodes.label: osf lint skill
nodes.subtitle: Skill front-matter and rule lint
nodes.summary: The lint command the new CI step runs over every discovered SKILL.md directory. Unchanged here; the change is that CI now calls it.

nodes.label: scan.rs tests
nodes.subtitle: Symlink-to-directory case
nodes.summary: Adds a test that a tracked symlink to a directory is skipped rather than read, plus a TempRepo::symlink helper that creates the link the way a real symlink resolves, on Unix and Windows.

nodes.label: ci.yml
nodes.subtitle: Build, lint, hygiene
nodes.summary: Gains two steps in the existing job: one lints every tracked skill directory, one fails the build unless .claude/skills is a git symlink pointing at ../.agents/skills.

nodes.label: Check the skills
nodes.subtitle: osf lint skill over every SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Lists skills/*/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md from git, and runs the release osf lint skill over each directory. Notices and exits cleanly when there are none.

nodes.label: Check the Claude Code skills link
nodes.subtitle: git mode must be 120000
nodes.summary: Reads the git index mode for .claude/skills and fails with a fix hint unless it is 120000 and readlink resolves to ../.agents/skills.

edges.label: ../.agents/skills

flows.title: CI lints every skill, then checks the symlink
flows.summary: What happens on a pull request: the job builds osf, discovers skill directories from the git index, lints each one, then verifies that .claude/skills is still a real symlink to the shared tree.

messages.label: cargo build --release --bin osf
messages.note: The release build already existed; the new steps depend on it.

messages.label: git ls-files 'skills/*/SKILL.md' '.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md'
messages.note: Discovery goes through the git index, so the symlinked path is not walked twice.

messages.label: osf lint skill --format human <dirs>
messages.note: Exits cleanly with a notice when no skill directories are found.

messages.label: git ls-files -s .claude/skills
messages.note: Expects index mode 120000; anything else fails the build with a Windows fix hint.

views.title: Where an agent's rules come from
views.summary: The root AGENTS.md keeps only cross-cutting rules and routes to folder-scoped files and skills; .claude/skills is a symlink so one skill tree serves every agent.

views.title: What CI now enforces
views.summary: The two new steps in ci.yml: lint every skill directory, and fail unless .claude/skills is a real symlink to ../.agents/skills.
